world.title: Museveni plays both sides in Parliament's Speaker battle
world.description: By backing Norbert Mao against his own party's candidate, the President is using the speakership race to keep rivals in check and shape his succession, President Yoweri Museveni's decision to invite opposition minister Norbert Mao to the National Resistance Movement's (NRM) parliamentary retreat at Kyankwanzi in April – and then praise his leadership qualities – was less politically open-minded than it looked. Insiders say it was a calculated move by an 81-year-old leader who, having secured what is probably his final term in January's elections, is trying to shape the post-Museveni Uganda from the inside.

science.title: Unraveling the evolution of an extraordinary photosynthesis in a tropical tree species
science.description: Plants use sunlight to convert water and carbon dioxide into energy-rich sugars and oxygen in various ways (photosynthesis). Drought is a major challenge in this process. A research team led by Wolfram Weckwerth at the University of Vienna has now demonstrated how a particularly water-efficient variant of this process (CAM) has evolved in diverse ways within a single tropical tree genus.

science.title: A 75-million-year-old fossil reveals a shocking tyrannosaur secret
science.description: Tyrannosaurs may be famous as fearsome apex predators, but new research reveals a more opportunistic—and slightly grim—side to their behavior. Using high-resolution 3D scans, a researcher identified precise bite marks on a massive tyrannosaur foot bone, showing that a smaller tyrannosaur had fed on the remains of a much larger relative over 75 million years ago.
